name: He 111 control yoke on its swing-over column
view: the yoke from the pilot's seat: the two upright grips joined by the curved bar, the hub on the swing-over arm that comes up from the right of the cockpit floor (it can be swung across to the other seat); no switches
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the yoke's outline reconstructed from the IL-2 Great Battles He 111 H-6 and H-16 notes, the War Thunder description and public museum cockpit photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
